question: If each vowel in the word ARTICULATE is changed to the letter immediately following it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter immediately preceding it in the English alphabetical order, then which of the following letters will appear more than twice in the group of letters thus formed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8f7ce26deb1ef3887ad28e058a5beca3b6fab9e8c68725dc2241136521138a9.png] 

**Given:**

Word: ARTICULATE

Rule: Vowels -> next letter, Consonants -> previous letter

Apply the rule to each letter:

 
• A -> B
 
• R -> Q
 
• T -> S&l
